Marie? May we talk?
true

true

true

false
Oui, though I feel as though I know what this is about... I have behaved poorly. Who told you ?
Bien sûr, ce salaud de diable ouvre sa bouche et vous raconte tout ! Il ne cherche qu'à m'embarrasser !
Chat ends.
It's not important.
Loid.
Roathe.
Si je le pouvais, je prendrais ce couteau qu'il aime tant utiliser pour agacer les autres et je le fourrerais là où seule Lua peut le voir !
I think it is, but I think you are wishing to spare my mood. So... I will not press you for more.
I think you are lying to spare my mood, so... I will not press you for more.
Forgive me. That was... untoward. I am une Sœur de Sol, and I must not lose my temper or loosen my tongue in such a way.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
I wish to keep what little dignity in this conversation that I might be allowed.
My anger is not directed at you. And I am always grateful for your honesty.
If you have come to speak with me about the row I had with M'sieur Tagfer, I shall not deny it occurred.
I assume the devil told you what the fight was regarding?
Evaluate expressions
He didn't need to tell me, I could guess. Entrati.
MarieTagferFight2a
MarieTagferFight2b
false
He did. Though he seemed more concerned about you than anything else.
MarieTagferFight2a
He did. He's concerned about the situation because I think he feels for the Cavia.
MarieTagferFight2b
No, honestly. He said only that I should check in on you.
false
Oui. M'sieur Tagfer were arguing over the topic of le Cardinal.
I do not know why the devil would have you believe such a thing. Or to what end it would serve him.
The devil sees three wounded animals and knows he can easily wield his charisme to have them fawning over him.
I do not know why the devil would have you do such a thing. Or what ends he believes it would serve him.
Tagfer is not the biggest supporter of Entrati, no.
I take it that the argument was a loud one.
All acts of supposed kindness toward me from the devil are in service of his goal - to turn me against le Cardinal. I know it.
He does this to turn the tide against me. He wishes to corrupt me against le Cardinal. To see me turn my back against him. I know it.
But... that is not what you are here to discuss. The fight was in regards to le Cardinal.
And this is what I do not understand ! Look at what they have been given !
Oui ! He called me stupide. He told me that I am nothing but a child.
And it was the topic of le Cardinal that M'sieur Tagfer and I were arguing over.
Please, start from the beginning. How did this whole fight start?
I can start to get a sense of why this fight happened.
Did he actually call you stupid and a child?
Oui. I made mention of le Cardinal, I do not even know what it was.
Worse, perhaps.
M'sieur Tagfer rolled his eyes and snorted. I asked him to explain his derision.
"You're a spawnling, Marie ! Innocent. Dependent on others your whole life. Curled up in your little nest of blind faith !"
"Albrecht is a dirty, stinking liar !"
"Surviving on what your elders chewed up and spat into your credulous gaping mouth-hole !"
Et j'ai répondu, "Look at the gifts you were given - the gifts of thought, of language, of Self!"
Update boolean MarieEntrati3
"You should be grateful to le Cardinal for all he has blessed you with."
Tagfer only knows his side of the story. Entrati's real motivations or opinions weren't... clearly explained.
I know how you feel about being "dependent" on others and I'm sorry he said those things to you.
Tagfer has good reasons to feel the way he does.
And how did he take that?
Oh, no...
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
Evaluate expressions
It still does not give him a right ! I do not know if he realizes how deep his words cut me. En outre -
Merci, I do not know if he knows how deep the knife of his words cut me.
If this is the welcome le Cardinal looks forward to enjoying upon his return, it is no wonder he stays away !
MarieEntratiFamily
And I am certain you take M'sieur Tagfer's side in all this, non ? You believe le Cardinal to be a monster just the same as the beast does.
MarieEntratiMonster1
MarieEntratiMonster2
I am surprised, je pensais que tu étais de mon côté ! Were you not joining me in championing le Cardinal's cause but a moment ago ?
MarieEntratiFan1
MarieEntratiFan2
What does it matter, as you said before ? We are to serve him in his deeds and judge him later. This fight is meaningless, non ?
MarieEntratiNeutral
I know they were made by the Void at le Cardinal's hands. All of us have been given gifts by le Cardinal that are a curse if viewed with a broken heart !
false
And do you know how deeply yours did? Do you know their whole story?
And what you said hurt him just as much.
I'm honestly on your side, but... we have to try to keep the peace, Marie.
Marie, please. I'm not trying to fight. I'm just trying to get you to understand what they've been through.
If Entrati stuck around to help clean up after his own messes, he might have more friends in this world.
Marie, please. I'm not trying to fight. I'm just trying to get you to understand what they've been through.
Yes, I am taking his side. Because you're not listening to reason. You have to understand "le Cardinal" is not what he seems.
Has this been some great deception of yours ? Have you been playing un jeu with little Marie ?
It matters if there's nobody left around us when we're on the other side of this. They've been through a lot.
I'm sure he'll forget about it. I'm sure you will, too.
All of us have been abandoned by him ! Tell me, how are they so much more wronged, that I must tolerate such hate ?!
Oui ?! Then tell me why !
The situation that the Cavia have been through has been... hard.
They're animals, even if they've been given intelligence, they're still animals. There's only so much they're capable of.
Oui ? Then do play the role of La Lumière Sacrée de Sol and banish the darkness ! Enlighten little foolish Marie !
Oui ! Yes, it is not good enough that he is attempting to save the known universe from a god of the Void, non ?!
No, I'm not lying. I'm with you. I'm just saying their situation has been... hard.
No, not a game, exactly...? Entrati isn't to be trusted, and I don't know how else to convince you but to pretend to be on your side.
Non ! You began this conversation, and you will continue it. Explique !
Evaluate expressions
If you are attempting to inspire me to sympathize instead with them and turn my wrath upon you, I am suddenly tempted.
Perhaps it is best we adjourn here. Before tempers get the best of all of us.
Oui ? Well, I am pleased to tell you, you have failed.
The Cavia were accidents created from experiments. Lab animals never meant to exist. The Void gave them intelligence.
MarieFamily2
MarieBackstory1
MarieInfestation
MarieLyonSuffering2

false
You said yourself "It is the ultimate form of cruelty, to be absent of a name." Entrati never bothered to name them, they were that worthless.
MarieFamily2
You told me the story of how you grew up on the streets. How your family threw you out because you weren't good enough for them.
MarieBackstory1
Think about how you would have felt, if you had simply been turned into a protoframe against your will and then abandoned?
MarieInfestation
Imagine how you would feel if Entrati just swooped in, turned Lyon into a protoframe, and abandoned him?
MarieLyonSuffering2
Perhaps it is best we adjourn here. Before tempers get the best of all of us.

Update boolean MarieEntratiFan1
And when Entrati saw what he had done? When he realized what he had created? These poor animals, speaking in Void-tongue, sick from exposure?
They were just things to him. Things to be used and thrown away. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
Your family thought you were you were worthless.
Imagine what it would have been like to have the Infestation in your blood, suffering, with no one there to say they cared?
Used him like a cheap science experiment, and then washed his hands of him? You all had each other to rely on before and after you changed. The Cavia didn't.
Chat ends.
Update boolean MarieEntratiFan2
He didn't care.
Bird 3? He's a bird with a number for a name. Fibonacci gave himself his name.
That is what the Cavia were to Entrati. Disposable lab animals. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
That your suffering even mattered? The Cavia were - are - worthless to Entrati. Disposable lab animals. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
To Entrati, the Cavia were just disposable lab animals. Worthless. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
Update boolean MarieNoDate
That is what the Cavia were to Entrati. Disposable. "Tagfer?" It means "Tag For Disposal."
Used in a Void experiment. Survivors in a long line of dead animals. Never intended to exist.
Chat ends.
The last of his kind. Tag For Disposal. His mate? Minn? The only other one left? Died in the experiment.
It's only because of Loid that they're still alive. He preserved them because he couldn't bring himself to euthanize them "per Entrati's instructions."
That's why he was mad, Marie. That's why he hates Entrati. And why he probably always will.
Oh, and Tagfer? He's the last of his kind. His mate, Minn? The only other one left? Died in the experiment.
Update boolean MarieEntrati3b
That's why he was mad, Marie. That's why he hates Entrati. And why he probably always will.
I know you believe he's doing what he thinks he needs to. And I know you believe in forgiveness. So do I. But you have to understand why for some people it's not possible. At least not yet.
There are some times when forgiveness isn't possible for people to muster for those who have hurt them. Certainly not now, and maybe not ever.
